<style>
/* Cicatrize 3X | Seção de oferta: bônus com faixa diagonal, valor, selo de economia.
   Vai num widget HTML dentro da própria seção (escopo .cz-oferta). */

body .cz-assets.elementor-widget {
  position: absolute;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ---------- Cartões de bônus ---------- */
.cz-oferta .cz-bonus.e-con {
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  transition: border-color 0.4s ease, box-shadow 0.4s ease, transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .cz-oferta .cz-bonus.e-con:hover {
    border-color: rgba(207, 138, 134, 0.9) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -28px rgba(207, 138, 134, 0.45);
  }
}

.cz-oferta .cz-bonus-media.e-con {
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
}

.cz-oferta .cz-bonus-img img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: 14px;
  transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .cz-oferta .cz-bonus:hover .cz-bonus-img img {
    transform: scale(1.05);
  }
}

/* Faixa diagonal "BÔNUS N" no canto superior esquerdo */
.cz-oferta .cz-bonus .cz-ribbon.elementor-widget {
  position: absolute !important;
  z-index: 4;
  top: 26px;
  left: -44px;
  width: 170px !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  transform: rotate(-45deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.cz-oferta .cz-ribbon .elementor-heading-title {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 7px 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #B86F6B, #CF8A86 50%, #B86F6B);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  text-align: center;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

/* brilho passando pela faixa */
.cz-oferta .cz-ribbon .elementor-heading-title::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -40%;
  width: 30%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55), transparent);
  transform: skewX(-20deg);
  animation: cz-ribbon-shine 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.cz-oferta .cz-bonus:nth-child(2) .cz-ribbon .elementor-heading-title::after { animation-delay: 0.6s; }
.cz-oferta .cz-bonus:nth-child(3) .cz-ribbon .elementor-heading-title::after { animation-delay: 1.2s; }
.cz-oferta .cz-bonus:nth-child(4) .cz-ribbon .elementor-heading-title::after { animation-delay: 1.8s; }

@keyframes cz-ribbon-shine {
  0%, 60% { left: -40%; }
  100% { left: 130%; }
}

/* Quem ganha: etiqueta */
.cz-oferta .cz-bonus-who .elementor-heading-title {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(207, 138, 134, 0.16);
}

/* Valor do bônus */
.cz-oferta .cz-bonus-price .elementor-heading-title {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 6px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}

.cz-oferta .cz-bonus-price span {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.cz-oferta .cz-bonus-price s {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

.cz-oferta .cz-bonus-price b {
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #CF8A86;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ---------- Cartão de preço ---------- */
.cz-oferta .cz-save .elementor-heading-title {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #CF8A86;
  animation: cz-save-pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.cz-oferta .cz-save .elementor-heading-title::before {
  content: "↓";
  font-weight: 900;
}

@keyframes cz-save-pulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(207, 138, 134, 0.5); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(207, 138, 134, 0); }
}

.cz-oferta .cz-trust .elementor-icon-list-items {
  gap: 6px 18px;
}

/* ---------- Celular: cartão de bônus horizontal ---------- */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .cz-oferta .cz-bonus.e-con > .cz-bonus-media {
    flex: 0 0 40%;
    max-width: 40%;
    width: 40%;
  }

  .cz-oferta .cz-bonus.e-con > .cz-bonus-info {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 0;
    width: auto;
  }

  .cz-oferta .cz-bonus .cz-ribbon.elementor-widget {
    top: 16px;
    left: -40px;
    width: 130px !important;
  }

  .cz-oferta .cz-ribbon .elementor-heading-title {
    padding: 5px 0;
    font-size: 10px !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em !important;
  }

  .cz-oferta .cz-bonus-who .elementor-heading-title {
    padding: 4px 9px;
    font-size: 10px !important;
  }

  .cz-oferta .cz-bonus-price .elementor-heading-title {
    padding-top: 6px;
    font-size: 12px !important;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .cz-oferta .cz-ribbon .elementor-heading-title::after,
  .cz-oferta .cz-save .elementor-heading-title {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}
</style>
